items.title: The Token HUD's Vigor (red) and Resolve (blue) boxes, where Foundry's Health box was
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token. In the red Vigor box type -5 and Enter; then +2; in the blue Resolve box type 3.
items.expect: The two boxes sit side by side under the token, where Foundry's own Health box was, both whole and clickable (nothing over them, not over the token). -5 deals 5 to Vigor only, +2 heals 2 of it, a plain number sets what is left of that pool (Resolve 3).

items.title: The status palette: the whole row is the button; a right-click lowers a value
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token and open its status effects. Click anywhere in Slowed's row (its frame, not only the icon or the word); click it again; then right-click it twice. Click Prone's row, then right-click it.
items.expect: The first click gives Slowed 1, the second makes it Slowed 2; each right-click lowers it by 1, and at 1 a right-click removes it. Prone's row toggles it with a click anywhere in the row; its right-click does Foundry's right-click (the large overlay icon).

items.title: A condition's number: none on the token, readable beside the chat and in the HUD
items.do: Give Orc Warrior Vulnerable 1 and Slowed 2 (the palette). Look at its token; select it and look at the effects beside the chat, then the HUD's conditions row. (A world from v0.0.501 or 502: reload it as GM first.)
items.expect: The token shows the plain icons (no number). Beside the chat, each valued icon has a large white number on a dark box at its lower right corner. In the HUD's row the number is bold after the icon.
